notes.title: Update is live
notes.content:
Now you can improve your cavemen with new skills and help them survive!

The skill “Hunter” gives you the opportunity to damage your prey during the hunt. With the “ Hunter” skill, you can turn the simplest weapon to a fatal one and produce more meat from the animals you hunted. Besides, it increases the chance of escaping from the animals which are stronger than you. Sometimes it is best to run :)

The skill “Inventor” earns you more science points. With the “Inventor” skill, you can do more by spending less stones. Who knows? Maybe the first scientist would be your caveman :)

With the skill “Digger”, you can gather more stones. Remember! Stones are vital for science points. The more stones you have mean the more science-y you are and science always increases your chance of survival.

The skill “Fisher” will increase your he amount of meat you obtained from the fish you hunted. More meat means that you can feed your tribe and keep them alive longer.

The skill “Scavenger” gives you the chance to collect more wood. By using “Scavenger” you can feed the tribal fire and earn more bonuses from the missions. Besides, “Scavenger” will increase the amount of bones you get from the animals you hunted. Do not forget that you use the bones to improve your skills. 

The skill “Farmer” provides you with the ability to obtain more food from the plants you gathered. It means longer life for your tribe.

Get ready to the struggles with two different rhinos!

With this update we present you a new location: The meadows. We can find various type of food in this vast green area. But beware! There are wild animals out there too. 

And here comes our newest NPC! With the help of this new character who enjoys playing games, you can find food and items that are essential for your survival easier than before. But this NPC is pretty lucky. Be careful what you sign for! 

The walls are not empty anymore. The cavemen invented art! The wall paintings can get you some bonuses for limited time. Use them carefully and have a quality lifetime.
